div.head: VII Atr 3
div.ab: Et precipimus, ut in omni congregatione cantetur cotidie communiter pro rege et omni populo suo una missa ad matutinalem missam, que inscripta est ‘contra paganos’.
Et praecipimus, ut in omni congregatione cantetur cotidie communiter pro rege et omni populo suo una missa ad matutinalem missam quae inscripta est 'contra paganos.'
And we decree that in every religious foundation a mass entitled "Against the heathen" shall be sung daily at matins, by the whole community, on behalf of the king and all his people.
Und wir befehlen, dass in jedem Convent täglich bei der Frühmette gemeinsam für den König und sein ganzes Volk Eine Messe gesungen werde, die betitelt ist ‘gegen die Heiden’.
And we command that in every community one mass be sung daily in common at the morning mass for the king and all his people, the one entitled ‘against the heathen’.
